verdict_reason: The new refusal tests are sound for the query and payload paths, but the session path's handling of an unlisted fulfilment id is untested.

todos.issue: The new tests (lines 74-83, 114-121) prove the query and payload paths refuse an unlisted fulfilment id, but no test covers a session handshake with a known journey type and an unlisted fulfilment id; the only session-refusal test (line 206) covers a retired journey type, so the gap in validatedSessionContext goes unnoticed
todos.fix: Must: a test proves resolveHandshakeContext clears and ignores a session handshake whose fulfilment id the journey does not list, and it fails against the current isKnownJourneyType check. One way: copy the line 206 case with { ...validContext, fulfilmentId: 'not-a-fulfilment-id' } and assert both resolveHandshakeContext and loadHandshakeContext return null
